Folio / optional English neural voice pack (en-v1)
=================================================
Folio's MIT license covers its own code. The third-party components below retain their separate licenses. Redistribute these notices and the corresponding files with the voice pack. This pack contains no system voices, hosted TTS API or voice cloning.

1. KittenTTS Nano 0.8 int8 model and supplied voice embeddings
   KittenML. Apache License, Version 2.0, as identified by the model publisher.
   en-v1/kitten_tts_nano_v0_8.onnx and en-v1/voices.npz are the byte-for-byte original files.
   Source revision: https://huggingface.co/KittenML/kitten-tts-nano-0.8-int8/tree/84781d74e29ee25217551556398b42f80593a813
   Original model card and license: licenses/KittenModelCard.md and licenses/Apache-2.0.txt.
   The model card credits the StyleTTS 2 architecture. These are v0.8 weights, not KittenTTS 2.x.

2. KittenTTS Web SDK / CEPhonemizer
   KittenML. Apache License, Version 2.0 (licenses/Apache-2.0.txt). CEPhonemizer source bears its own 2024 Apache 2.0 headers. The rule DATA files are covered separately under (5).
   Source: https://github.com/KittenML/KittenTTS-web/tree/c846fe92858f3447f4912226471f5a63983b3f94
   Input: examples/html/assets/kittentts-web.js from that exact revision.
   Input SHA-256: 6bbc1d35555d6c7f25dc9d69c9f870f5d436b6040a58240ab61c30d60126899c
   FOLIO MODIFICATIONS (2026-11-23): removed the optional wasm-media-encoders MP3 module and embedded encoder, replaced encoding with an unavailable PCM-only stub, disabled generation telemetry and its endpoint, and added a prominent modification header. For the exact reproducible edits see tools/voices/prepare-sdk.py in the source distribution. Folio uses PCM/WAV output. The optional MP3 binaries are NOT distributed here.
   Upstream CEPhonemizer is compiled via Emscripten; its C++ sources are in vendor/cephonemizer/ and build flags in scripts/build-cephonemizer.cjs.

   Supplemental compiler and C/C++ runtime notices (the SDK does not specify the exact emcc build): licenses/Emscripten-upstream.txt (MIT or NCSA, plus Node portions), licenses/Musl-upstream.txt (MIT and component exceptions), licenses/Libcxx-upstream.txt and licenses/Libcxxabi-upstream.txt (LLVM licenses, including exceptions). Reference notice texts:
Emscripten: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/emscripten-core/emscripten/4.0.23/LICENSE
Musl: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/emscripten-core/emscripten/4.0.23/system/lib/libc/musl/COPYRIGHT
Libcxx: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/llvm/llvm-project/llvmorg-20.1.8/libcxx/LICENSE.TXT
Libcxxabi: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/llvm/llvm-project/llvmorg-20.1.8/libcxxabi/LICENSE.TXT

3. ONNX Runtime Web 1.26.0 / ONNX Runtime common and native dependencies
   Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation. MIT; accompanying third-party terms apply to their respective components.
   The SDK includes ORT's wasm JS bundle; the two separate en-v1/ort-wasm-simd-threaded.* runtime files are unchanged from npm onnxruntime-web@1.26.0, dist/.
   Original package: https://registry.npmjs.org/onnxruntime-web/-/onnxruntime-web-1.26.0.tgz
   Npm SHA-512 (base64): LbRr/8zZt2xilI2smrVQGGKINo0U46i8qJp+UXyMBGfqN7KjnH1BiwCwLwyNIVV4i9CKFv7Sf4PwLKWnT8/bEA==
   Include licenses/ONNX-Runtime-MIT.txt and licenses/ONNX-ThirdPartyNotices.txt. Microsoft's web npm tarball does not ship these as standalone files; this copy is from Microsoft's same-version published ORT 1.26.0 binary distribution (not all listed components are present in the web build):
   https://pypi.org/project/onnxruntime/1.26.0/#files
   Notice source: onnxruntime-1.26.0-cp311-cp311-win_arm64.whl, SHA-256 cd920e45b730e4a87833e2910d8ca375aaca9da6ccc09e24bce463b3356d637f.

4. Pako 2.1.0 (inflation of the voice archive)
   Pako project: https://github.com/nodeca/pako/tree/2.1.0
   Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/pako/-/pako-2.1.0.tgz
   The SDK includes pako (MIT AND Zlib). See the original complete licenses and credits in licenses/Pako-MIT.txt and licenses/Pako-Zlib-notice.txt.

5. eSpeak NG English pronunciation rule and dictionary SOURCE DATA
   en-v1/en_rules and en-v1/en_list are unmodified, human-editable upstream source, not compiled dictionaries. They are distributed separately from the app's MIT code and the SDK; these two files remain licensed under GNU GPL version 3 or, at your option, any later version. The corresponding source for each is the distributed file itself.
   Full license: licenses/eSpeak-NG-GPL-3.0.txt. Retain the original headers and this notice.
   Original source: https://github.com/espeak-ng/espeak-ng/tree/59eb19938f12e30881c81d86ce4a7de25414c9f4/dictsource
   en_rules credits Jonathan Duddington (2005-2014) and Reece H. Dunn (2016-2017); en_list is from the eSpeak NG project. The source bytes match the pinned upstream files exactly.
